name: E0047 - continuation parity closure for frozen E0041 D

historical_flow_representation.join_behavior: Exact Opened-key searchsorted join; matched values are indexed first and then cast with np.asarray(..., dtype=np.float32); unmatched values remain float32 NaN; Arrow pa.float32 columns are appended before writing the joined BASE70 artifact. No imputing or feature transform is applied to FLOW at this join.
required_operation_order: raw FLOW features calculated in float64 by features/btc_taker_flow.py
matched FLOW values cast once to float32 in the E0041 join and persisted as Arrow float
full ordered model matrix cast to float32 before LightGBM inference
historical_flow_representation.representation_condition: Exact equality of finite float32 values, exact NaN/+Inf/-Inf masks, and exact Opened keys; no tolerance change or additional rounding.

continuation.raw_cursor: Source CSV byte offset, row count, last processed Opened, and next expected Opened; resume seeks to the cursor and never scans/recomputes a prior prefix except unavoidable read-only Parquet/CSV block overlap, which is measured.

tail_sufficiency.candle_resample_and_lags: 8 complete 1d buckets plus one boundary row cover the maximum selected candle lag (1d lag7) and incomplete aggregation; smaller intervals are nested within that bound.
tail_sufficiency.finite_indicator_and_basis_windows: The saved selected indicator parameters require at most 2000 raw minutes; basis intervals are at most 1d; 12001 rows exceed these finite windows.
tail_sufficiency.realized_volatility: The largest frozen rolling window is 240 returns; the full 12001-row raw tail and serialized 240-return state preserve warmup and recurrence semantics.
tail_sufficiency.streaks: Unbounded signed streak count, current sign, in-flight interval candle OHLC/count, and last complete interval are serialized; not inferred from a finite tail.
tail_sufficiency.RP_VP: Use the frozen E0041 config and the existing save/load state APIs; serialize arrays, scales, counters, last candle timestamp, config signatures, and exact update-before-emit ordering.
tail_sufficiency.ADX_TEMA: Serialize the three TA-Lib EMA stages and warmup count for the selected TEMA(640); retain raw tail for finite TR/WMA/GMA/NWMA inputs.
tail_sufficiency.Chaikin_ADL: Serialize the cumulative ADL state; retain raw tail for the maximum finite HMA window and preserve the frozen update order.
tail_sufficiency.FLOW6: Keep 10,095 exact raw USD-M rows (the 10,080 beta window plus the maximum 15-row horizon shift); recompute with the frozen E0045 formula and compare before and after the historical float32 conversion.
tail_sufficiency.memory_ESN: Serialize the existing CausalMemoryState and all ESNEngine checkpoints, plus last/next timestamps and frozen transform identities.
tail_sufficiency.BollingerBands: Checkpoint exact tindicators LMA(8) recurrence state and the last 593 squared-deviation inputs used by NWMA_EPAN(594); no tail-based accumulator reset.
tail_sufficiency.Chaikin_HMA: Checkpoint exact TA-Lib WMA(446), WMA(893), and final WMA(29) recurrence state and their input rings, plus the last Chaikin oscillator value; keep seven prior ADL values for NWMA_EPAN(8).
tail_sufficiency.VP_batch_arithmetic: Advance each horizon using the frozen batch kernel arithmetic order: volume/total_weight, then divide by global scale, then multiply each bin weight.

comparison_rules.join_keys: Exact unique ordered Opened timestamp keys; never pair by position without first proving key identity.
comparison_rules.BASE64_and_FLOW6_raw: atol=rtol=1e-10 with exact NaN/+Inf/-Inf masks and timestamp identity.
comparison_rules.dynamic_memory_ESN: atol=rtol=2e-6 after the frozen float32 transformations, with exact masks and timestamp identity.
comparison_rules.prediction_panel: atol=rtol=2e-12 for each of nine saved members, uniform 1/9 mean, and saved Platt transform; no labels or metrics.
comparison_rules.model_matrices: Every common development row through Opened=2026-06-30T23:53:00Z; all 86 ordered float32 values per reservoir seed compared exactly after exact masks and keys.
comparison_rules.flow_product_representation: All common development rows, raw-derived float64 values cast at the historical join site versus final E0041 BASE70 Arrow float values; exact finite-value and mask equality. Four post-reference FLOW rows remain separate.
comparison_rules.flow_postcast_aggregation: Aggregate only flow_representation_float32 records; verify exactly six frozen features, all expected ordered Opened keys, no duplicate or overlapping partitions, total rows per feature and exact NaN/+Inf/-Inf masks. Diagnostic float64 precision loss is separate.
comparison_rules.recursive_states: Exact arrays/scales/counters/updates; allow only ordered tuple/list representation and an explicitly parsed same-instant UTC last_candle_time representation. Numeric values are never rounded or tolerance-normalized.
comparison_rules.resumed_model_matrices: Left side must read actual E0047 suffix BASE64/FLOW6/dynamic products and the checkpoint-generated raw suffix; compare every model-range row and all 86 ordered float32 columns exactly against E0041 canonical matrices.
comparison_rules.resumed_predictions: Compute the nine saved members, uniform mean and saved Platt only on frozen panel keys intersecting each actual resumed model range; compare at atol=rtol=2e-12. The 64-row June 30 finalization panel must be complete for C1_to_END and C2_to_END.

resource_limits.basis: E0046 observed maximum peak RSS 1.697 GiB and about 0.10 GiB workspace growth; retain at least 6 GiB RAM and 9.9 GiB disk headroom beyond these measured needs.

amendment: E0047 repairs the FLOW post-cast aggregator, carries exact Bollinger LMA and Chaikin TA-Lib WMA recurrence state, restores exact batch VP addition order, emits recursive profile-state diffs, and validates matrices/predictions directly from all three resumed suffix products. It preserves the E0046 artifacts and the E0041 bundle. Development-only; no fitting or holdout payload access.
